notes: 'to be lacking' is the complement of the hiphil's causative frame, so the verb's unit heads there rather than on 'suffer' (rule 44).
מֵעַל read as a rule 30 fusion on the single 'from'; the split reading is named in that unit's note.
No article morpheme stands in מֶלַח בְּרִית אֱלֹהֶיךָ, so each written 'the' is supplied to the word it stands before under rule 29.

The unit note on מִנְחָתֶךָ describes it as discontinuous around the suffix's 'thy', but 'thy' precedes both of its tokens and the unit is contiguous; the token assignment itself is correct, so this is a descriptive slip only.
